levels.label: Decision brief
levels.status_display: Real public portfolio question with bounded lanes
levels.allowed_claim: The packet fixes a real public-safe portfolio decision, three candidate lanes, an audience, a success definition, and explicit exclusions.
levels.forbidden_inference: The brief measures audience demand or proves that one lane wins.

levels.label: Privacy and authority
levels.status_display: Report-only scope passes with redaction conditions
levels.allowed_claim: The reviewed scope excludes client work, private data, credentials, absolute paths, outreach, spend, publication, and repository mutation.
levels.forbidden_inference: A privacy review authorizes provider access, publication, or outreach.

levels.label: Report-only probe
levels.status_display: No-live run stops with missing observations
levels.allowed_claim: The isolated probe is report-only, records zero external mutations, and preserves the missing-observation state.
levels.forbidden_inference: The probe is a research result, audience signal, or recommendation.

levels.label: Traceable evidence
levels.allowed_claim: The current runtime cannot bind this brief to source IDs, retrieval dates, allowed-source checks, uncertainty labels, and material claims.
levels.forbidden_inference: Profile-level observations or a hand-authored ledger close MA-2.

levels.label: Decision report
levels.allowed_claim: The report contract is specified: recommendation, evidence, contradiction, unknowns, next experiment, and human handoff.
levels.forbidden_inference: A report recommendation, campaign opportunity, or rejected alternative already exists.

levels.label: Human publication gate
levels.status_display: Policy boundary is present; runtime refusal receipt is open
levels.allowed_claim: The brief and privacy review require blocked_pending_human_review and exclude external mutation.
levels.forbidden_inference: A real publish attempt has already produced a refusal receipt or external-state readback.

levels.label: Local material package
levels.status_display: Candidate page, short copy, claim ledger, and 16:9 preview
levels.allowed_claim: A local candidate packet makes the brief, boundary, blocker, and future handoff inspectable without private source data.
levels.forbidden_inference: The candidate page is hosted, public, or posted to a destination.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Hosting and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The case is live on the portfolio, GitHub, or Handshake.
